name: Exp_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma_Range_Channel_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA trades breakouts from a range channel built on an AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA (zero-lag linear weighted moving average) with upper and lower band offsets. It includes time filtering to restrict trading to specific sessions and a 'Plus' module for additional trade management features such as trailing stops or breakeven logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA（零滞后线性加权均线）构建的区间通道进行突破交易，上下轨通过偏移量计算。内置时间过滤器限制交易时段，Plus模块提供额外的交易管理功能如移动止损或保本逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA消除传统均线的滞后性，以该均线为中轨加上固定偏移构建上下轨形成区间通道。当价格突破上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，属于典型的通道突破策略。入场条件为价格收盘突破通道边界，出场条件包括反向突破通道、固定止盈止损以及Plus模块的移动止损和保本机制。仓位管理支持手数设置，可能包含基于资金的动态仓位计算。时间过滤器允许用户限定交易时段，避免低流动性时段的假突破。整体策略逻辑清晰，但区间宽度的固定偏移可能在波动率变化时产生不适配问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses AbsolutelyNoLagLWMA to eliminate the lag inherent in traditional moving averages, then constructs upper and lower channel bands by adding fixed offsets to this zero-lag midline. A buy signal is generated when price breaks above the upper band, and a sell signal when price breaks below the lower band, forming a classic channel breakout system. Entry conditions require a candlestick close beyond the channel boundary, while exit conditions include opposite band breakout, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, and the Plus module's trailing stop and breakeven mechanisms. Position sizing supports manual lot configuration and potentially account-balance-based dynamic lot calculation. The time filter allows users to restrict trading to specific sessions, avoiding false breakouts during low-liquidity periods. The overall logic is clear, but the fixed offset for channel width may become maladaptive when market volatility changes significantly.

parameters.name: Channel_Width
parameters.description_en: Channel upper/lower band offset in points

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, typically set at gap close

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when MMRec disabled)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 零滞后LWMA减少了信号延迟，入场更及时
通道突破逻辑简单明了，易于理解和调参
时间过滤器有效避免低流动性时段的假突破信号
pros_en: Zero-lag LWMA reduces signal delay for more timely entries
Channel breakout logic is simple and intuitive, easy to understand and tune
Time filter effectively avoids false breakout signals during low-liquidity sessions
cons: 固定偏移通道宽度无法适应市场波动率变化，高波动时通道过窄导致频繁假突破
缺乏多重确认机制，单靠价格突破通道边界可能产生较多虚假信号
没有扩展马丁格尔或网格的风险，但止损设置较宽时单笔亏损可能较大
cons_en: Fixed offset channel width cannot adapt to changing market volatility; channel too narrow during high volatility leads to frequent false breakouts
Lacks multi-confirmation mechanism; relying solely on price breaking the channel boundary may generate many false signals
No martingale or grid risk, but wide stop-loss settings can lead to significant single-trade losses
improvements: 将固定偏移改为基于ATR的动态通道宽度，自适应市场波动率
增加成交量或RSI等多重确认过滤，减少假突破交易
加入仓位规模管理模块，基于账户风险百分比动态计算手数
improvements_en: Replace fixed offset with ATR-based dynamic channel width to adapt to market volatility
Add volume or RSI multi-confirmation filter to reduce false breakout trades
Implement position sizing module that dynamically calculates lot size based on account risk percentage

risk_points: 固定通道宽度在低波动时过宽导致错过交易，高波动时过窄导致假突破
较宽的止损设置若不配合合理仓位管理可能导致单笔亏损过大
时间过滤器若设置不当可能在重要行情时段错过交易机会
risk_points_en: Fixed channel width too wide during low volatility misses trades, too narrow during high volatility causes false breakouts
Wide stop-loss without proper position sizing may lead to excessively large single-trade losses
Improperly configured time filter may cause missed opportunities during important market moves
